_comment: Hand-written showcase copy. scripts/build-showcase.py merges it with the Skills/ tree and rewrites the generated regions of site/index.html. The tree decides WHICH skills, categories, groups and counts appear; this file only supplies the words and glyphs. A Core skill with no entry here still gets a card, built from its SKILL.md frontmatter.

core.name: repo-docs-builder
core.tagline: A repository that reads top to bottom like somebody meant it.
features: Layout: app under src/ or site/, root stays docs and meta
A docs tree wired with down-links and up-links
A house-style README at every level, not just the root
A humanizer pass over every sentence of prose
Renders natively in both GitHub and Obsidian

core.name: business-plan-builder
core.alt: The generated output folder for a Hotel-Loyalty-Club idea, with analysis, decisions, models and research subfolders
core.tagline: Eight passes from napkin idea to decision memo — with a gate that can say no.
features: Market sizing: TAM/SAM/SOM, JTBD, Five Forces
Competitive intelligence with graded evidence
An ROI model plus a sensitivity sweep
A decision memo gates the build half — a no-go is a complete run
Output is a linked markdown repo; every number sourced or tagged

core.name: recipe-validator
core.alt: A recipe under review: an Indiana pork tenderloin sandwich with its ingredient list and ten numbered steps
core.tagline: A script does the arithmetic. You supply the judgment.
features: Food-safety temperatures and dangerous-technique flags
Sodium, saturated-fat and added-sugar thresholds per serving
Quantity and ratio sanity against comparable recipes
Allergen-label completeness and overall coherence
Findings ranked by severity, each with a concrete fix

core.name: html-email-templates
core.alt: A security advisory digest email: a dark banner heading over tables of new and updated CVEs
core.tagline: Three email templates that survive the clients that strip your CSS.
features: Template A — inline notification or alert for the body
Template B — dark banner report wrapper, attached or linked
Template C — light-card digest, safe to inline
Shared footer plus subject-line and label conventions
Transport-agnostic: Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, SES, SMTP

core.name: task-router
core.alt: Routing diagram: a request is sized, then dispatched to one of four tiers from answer inline up to fan out
core.tagline: Size the job before you spend on it — then pick the model to match.
features: Four execution shapes: inline, one subagent, recon-then-plan, fan out
Picks a model tier to match the shape it chose
The cost policy is a parameter — set it once
The authorization gate for delegation, at the tier it selects

core.name: news-images
core.alt: A cartoon-editorial news montage, the week's stories woven into one illustrated scene
features: Four cadences: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly
Collage — a six-panel grid at 1024 × 1536
Montage — one continuous scene at 1536 × 1024
Researches the stories, lays out the frame, produces the PNG
A dedicated prompt file for each of the eight variants

core.name: project-hub-scaffold
core.alt: The Project Hub explorer: a sidebar document tree beside a dashboard of workspace repos
core.tagline: A clickable document tree over any folder — no build, no install.
features: A zero-dependency Node server plus a static explorer
Mode A — add a workspace to an existing Hub
Mode B — a portable installation that carries its own engine
Mode C — match an existing Hub page's theme and tree
Source: github.com/ai-automation-tools/project-hub (MIT)

core.name: automated-dev-pipeline
core.alt: Pipeline flow: ideas become scored plans and private repos, roadmap PRs merge through one sweep, and a repo goes public only after scripted gates and a human approval
core.tagline: Scheduled agents that build, publish and maintain repos — with a person at the one step that can't be undone.
features: Ideas become scored plans, then private repos built one roadmap item per PR
One PR sweep reviews and merges what every routine opened
Going public takes scripted gates and a human approval
Keep-current jobs refresh every repo against what it depends on
A single-repo variant: stages as folders, a merge that deploys a site
